none: No template yet. Write a project, then use “Keep as a template”.
sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.hint: They can start projects from it, not change or delete it. Never put secrets in a template you share.
useTip: Fills the new project with this template. You can still change everything before creating it.
deleteConfirm: Delete the template {{name}}? Projects already made from it are not affected.
keepTip: Saves this compose text as a reusable template
